target.statement: Logistic Regression surrogate classifier held-out test macro-F1 = 0.963 for predicting K-means k=4 cluster membership
target.dataset: NDNS Rolling Programme Years 12-15 (2019-2023), adult analytical sample n=2,146

compute.basis: Clustering + logistic regression on ~2k x 25 features is trivial compute, but the NDNS microdata require UK Data Service registration/approval and the entire feature-engineering pipeline (25 energy-adjusted variables from raw Intake24 nutrient/food-group files) must be rebuilt from scratch with no code.

blockers: NDNS microdata behind UK Data Service access conditions (registration/approval, not freely downloadable)
No code or repository linked; full preprocessing/feature-engineering pipeline must be reimplemented from prose
Exact cluster labels depend on unspecified seeds/preprocessing details, so macro-F1 may not match exactly
title: An Explainable Unsupervised-to-Supervised Machine Learning Framework for Dietary Pattern Discovery Using UK National Dietary Survey Data
